fact: The data centre managed by ASIN hosts the ministries' application architectures, the national interoperability platform and the national public services portal, and in August 2026 ASIN awarded a 2026-2028 contract to renew software rights for the state data centre's equipment.
title: Souveraineté tech : comment la SBIN s'est fait évincer d'un contrat clé de l'ASIN
